data.name: Casae In Silva
data.detailed_description:
In this first-person psychological horror game, the woods themselves feel alive and hostile, filled with distorted shadows and unsettling noises that echo from the treeline. To survive, you must navigate the twisting, claustrophobic paths of the wilderness, carefully managing your light source while searching for answers.

The heart of your journey relies on piecing together a dark, fragmented narrative scattered throughout the environment. As you explore abandoned cabins, overgrown ruins, and forgotten campsites, you will collect blood-stained notes and discarded journals left behind by previous victims. These pages expose the grim history of the woods and offer cryptic clues necessary to solve intricate, objective based puzzles. You will need to decode cryptic symbols, all while a relentless, fierce entity stalks you from the fog.

You will be 

-collecting notes

-Setting out to find clues 

-Problem solving

-Solving puzzles

-Solving riddles

-All whilst running for your life

data.short_description: Casae in Silva is a puzzle-based horror game with two Research Journalists that thought their adventures were getting stale. Due to these discouraging feelings the two set out to visit a remote location, seeking the old thrill they used to feel. While discovering the secrets within the wilderness.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit, version 21H1 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super 6 GB or AMD RX 5600 XT 6 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: SSD required. Intended for 1080p using the Performance preset and Low/Balanced lighting. Integrated graphics are not supported.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12600K or AMD Ryzen 7 5700X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4070 12 GB or AMD RX 7800 XT 16 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible V12
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Intended for 1440p using the PC preset and Balanced/High lighting, targeting approximately 60–100 FPS depending on the scene.
